title: pemfile: Avoid redundant root certificate parsing and memory allocations when root cert file is unchanged
body:
In `maybeUpdateRootFile()`, `x509.NewCertPool()` and `AppendCertsFromPEM()` were being executed on every tick/refresh, even when the underlying root certificate file contents had not changed. This caused unnecessary CPU overhead and memory allocations for parsing PEM blocks and x509 certificates repeatedly on unchanged files.
Move `bytes.Equal(w.rootFileContents, rootFileContents)` to immediately after `os.ReadFile`, prior to certificate pool creation and PEM parsing. This exits early when file contents match cached contents, aligning `maybeUpdateRootFile()` with the existing behavior in `updateIdentityDistributor()` and `maybeUpdateSPIFFEBundleMap()`.
Added `TestWatcher_RootFileUnchanged_NoCertParsing` to verify that repeated calls on an unchanged root file skip certificate parsing allocations.

RELEASE NOTES: none
